signIn.name: Your name

slack.intro: Connecting Slack gives the CRM a way in and a way out. What it actually does with that is up to you afterwards, one automation at a time.
slack.neverSend: Send anything at all until you build an automation and switch it on
slack.neverPost: Post anywhere except the destination approved in that automation
slack.neverRead: Read a direct message between two people
slack.approveNote: You approve the workspace in Slack. You can disconnect it here at any time.
slack.startWith: Afterwards, most teams start with one of these
slack.startWithNote: Suggestions, not settings. None of them exist until you pick one and switch it on.
slack.dealCreatedDetail: Post the deal to an approved sales channel.
slack.dealWonDetail: Tell an approved channel that the deal closed.
slack.dealReopenedDetail: Notify one approved channel or teammate.
slack.grantedAgents: Here is what Slack gave us. Agents only post where their automation says.
slack.grantedAdmin: Here is what Slack gave us. Only an owner or an admin can disconnect it.
slack.noPeopleReviewed: No workspace people have been reviewed yet.
slack.noPrivateChannels: OPENVZ AI cannot reach private channels
slack.reconnectToAsk: Reconnect to ask again. You lose nothing.
slack.alreadyIn: OPENVZ AI is already in there.
slack.askInvite: Ask someone inside to invite OPENVZ AI.
slack.reading: Reading the channel list from Slack.

slack.noChannels: No channels yet. OPENVZ AI reads the list from Slack after it connects.
slack.copyFailed: Copying failed. Copy the command above by hand.

tracking.description: Track website visitors and automatically add contacts when a form is submitted.

tracking.secureCookiesHint: Send the cookie over HTTPS and drop it on plain HTTP
tracking.doNotTrackHint: Record nothing at all when the browser asks not to be tracked
tracking.cookiesDescription: How a returning visitor is recognised.
tracking.crossDomainHint: Carry the visitor between the domains below, so one journey is not counted as two people
tracking.limitDomains: Limit tracking to the domains below

tracking.rulesDescription: Where the script may run, and how it follows a visitor.
tracking.trafficSourcesDescription: Where your visitors come from. Only people who have submitted a form are attributed to a record.
